text:
noah: Starting a focused follow-up thread from the postmortem. We had a cluster: control-plane jitter in two GCP regions, model-catalog auth flips (401 bursts), and IdP throttling on Okta. Need owners, short-term mitigations, and a clear tracker. I'll open the ticket after we agree.

isabel: I can take model-catalog auth. Root cause appears to be a token refresh worker crashing during a KMS rotation which left some services with invalid creds. Short-term: cached last-known-good token fallback + a dedicated metric for refresh failures. ETA: 3 business days for patch + feature flagged rollout. Preventative control: pre-rotation canary (rotate 1% + validate).

quentin: I'll own control-plane routing and circuit-breaker policies. Short-term: introduce per-route failover preferences and lower the circuit-breaker threshold for control-plane errors. Also add an automatic region-steer when control-plane error rate > 3% for 5m. ETA: 4 business days for config + canary. Long-term: provider SLA escalation and automated capacity steering.

sasha: I'll handle IdP/Okta side. Short-term: add exponential backoff + record x-rate-limit headers into logs/metrics so we can quantify throttles per-tenant. ETA: 2 business days. Preventative: per-tenant adaptive throttling hysteresis.

ops-bot: Created tracker EDRW-422: https://redwood.internal/incidents/EDRW-422 (vendor-dep-mitigations). Owners: please add checklist items with timeboxes.

noah: Short-term checklist I want pasted to EDRW-422 (short-term = sprint <=2w, long-term = quarter):
  - [ ] isabel  model-catalog cached-token fallback + refresh-metric  ETA 3d  preventative: pre-rotation canary
  - [ ] quentin  route failover + lower circuit-breaker + region-steer  ETA 4d  preventative: automated region health gating
  - [ ] sasha  Okta backoff + rate-limit logging  ETA 2d  preventative: per-tenant throttling hysteresis
  - [ ] infra  KMS rotation audit (INFRA-931)  ETA 7d

isabel: Sample Prometheus alert I'll add for the token issue:

  alert: ModelCatalogTokenRefreshSpike
  expr: increase(model_catalog_token_refresh_failures[10m]) > 20
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: critical

quentin: Example routing policy snippet (will refine in PR):

  {
    "route": "completion",
    "preference": ["gcp-us-west1","aws-us-east-1"],
    "failover_on": "control_plane_error",
    "circuit_breaker": {
      "error_rate_threshold": 0.03,
      "window": "5m"
    }
  }

sasha: Okta proxy quick patch plan: log x-rate-limit-remaining and x-rate-limit-reset headers, increment okta_rate_limit_count metric, and add 429-exponential backoff. Canary behind feature flag: 5% -> 25% -> full.

infra-bot: KMS audit ticket INFRA-931 created. ETA 7 business days.

noah: Ops asks before I close this thread: 1) add one-line "preventative control" to your checklist item (what would've prevented recurrence), 2) tag all related alerts with label external_dep=true so our regression detector surfaces them. Also include rollout/canary plan in PRs.

isabel: Added preventative control: "pre-rotation canary + healthcheck gate" to ticket. Will include rollout notes in PR.

quentin: Added preventative control: "automated region health steering + control-plane SLOs" and will include canary plan (5% -> 25% -> 100%) in PR.

sasha: Added preventative control: "per-tenant throttling hysteresis". Patch will include canary and rollback steps.

ops-bot: EDRW-422 updated with checklist items and statuses. Next review scheduled for weekly ops sync.

noah: Thanks everyone. Closing the thread  please update EDRW-422 with PR links, runbook edits, and canary results before the ops sync. :thumbsup:
